exposure: stage of cervical cancer (early vs. advanced)
type of treatment initiated (surgery, chemoradiotherapy, palliative care)
outcome: achievement of national treatment targets for surgery
achievement of national treatment targets for palliative care
achievement of national treatment targets for chemoradiotherapy
cohort: The participants were 583 cervical cancer patients presenting to the Uganda Cancer Institute (UCI) between January 2017 and March 2018.
finding: Daily clinical practice for cervical cancer at the Uganda Cancer Institute differed from national treatment targets, primarily because most women presented with advanced stage disease and the target for chemoradiotherapy was not met due to limited availability.
